Offriti di costruire il modellino dell’u: Offer to build the man’s model. Work at the table in your room each evening until it is finished, then deliver it and return to the Fox.
Parla alla ragazza sul tetto nei giorni: Speak to the girl on the rooftop on days without rain. Help her speak: Do you need help speaking? → Give her lessons. Return the following day and suggest Apologize to her. After confirmation, report back to the Fox.
Chiedi all’uomo dei gatti. Fuori da casa: Ask the man about cats. Interact with the cat outside the Dojima residence and bring the man to see it. Give him a Red Goldfish the next day; meet him again to finish, then return to the Fox.
Parla alla donna presso il cestino. Scen: Speak to the woman by the bin. Go down to the Riverbank and search the bushes near the sign at the foot of the stairs: Round Wallet. Show it to the woman; it is the wrong one. Then search the bushes outside the shrine entrance: Square Wallet. Deliver it and report back to the Fox.
Sblocca la spiaggia con lo scooter; prov: Unlock the beach by riding the scooter; try fishing there, then ask the old man by the river about the rod and the Guardian. Catch a Guardian using an Inaba Jewel Beetle and show it to him to obtain the sea fishing rod. Ask about sea bait, catch the Sea Guardian using a Genji Beetle, show it to the old man and return to the Fox.

Raccogli Leaf Pochette dopo aver accetta: Collect Leaf Pochette after accepting the request and deliver it to the twin.
Trova Gentleman’s Tux in un forziere dor: Find Gentleman’s Tux in a golden chest in Yukiko’s Castle and show it to the woman. Bring Chest Key.
Compra Barrier Corn, coltivalo e conserv: Buy Barrier Corn, grow it and keep one Tetracorn and one Makaracorn; deliver both. If one type is missing, grow another crop.
Raccogli Eternal Lamp dopo l’accettazion: Collect Eternal Lamp after accepting the request and deliver it to the man.
Conserva tre Fashionable Dishes e conseg: Keep three Fashionable Dishes and deliver them to the reader after Q34. They are regular materials: you can gather them before August.

Ottieni Crystal Ball e consegnala alla p: Obtain Crystal Ball and deliver it to the teacher.
